en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta), Chapter on the Nataṁdaḷha Group (Nataṁdaḷhavagga)
“The wise do not call that a strong bond which is made of iron, wood, or rope;”
The passion and infatuation for jewels and earrings,
and that longing for children and wives—
this, the wise say, is a firm bond.
“Carrying away, slack, and difficult to release—
having cut even this as well, the wise go on,
free from longing, having abandoned sensual pleasure.”
The Bandhanāgāra Jātaka is the first.
